title_en: The Mahdi (peace be upon him) in the Sahih Works of the School of the Companions (Part 1)
description_en: The Mahdi (peace be upon him) in the Sahih works of the School of the Companions (Part 1), an episode of the Mahdist Thesis program by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari on Al-Kawthar TV channel.
summary: His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari examines mentions of the Mahdi in the sound hadith collections of the school of the Companions, broadcast on Al-Kawthar TV.
